Flow.description: Update "Quote Approved" checkbox on opportunity when a related quote status is marked approved. Update Opportunity Stage based on Quote status. If quote status is "pending", clear value on oppty for QA and SDA

value.stringValue: ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( [SBQQ__Quote__c].SBQQ__Status__c), "Declined" ) && NOT( ISPICKVAL( [SBQQ__Quote__c].SBQQ__Status__c, "Approved" ) ) && NOT( ISPICKVAL( [SBQQ__Quote__c].SBQQ__Status__c, "Not Submitted" ))
